messages:
maria_sales: FYI ACME wants a POC with our private control plane (no public internet). They asked for guidance: VPC Peering vs PrivateLink, and we need a clear list of routing/subnets for their infra team. POC target next week, need steps + an ops-ready snippet.
ben_solutions: PrivateLink is usually our go-to for cross-account private connectivity for POCs — avoids route table changes on customer side and is simpler for security reviews. Also supports ALB/NLB in our account + interface endpoint in theirs.
carla_neteng: Agreed. If we do PrivateLink, minimal route changes for them. Requirements from infra side:
- NLB in our VPC (svc-nlb-<env>) fronting the service on 443
- aws_vpc_endpoint (interface) created in customer subnets
- Security group on the endpoint allowing customer CIDR on 443
- VPC endpoints don't need route table edits like peering does
ben_solutions: Quick terraform example we use for PrivateLink (POC):
```
resource "aws_lb" "svc_nlb" { }
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint_service" "redwood" {
  network_load_balancer_arns = [aws_lb.svc_nlb.arn]
  acceptance_required = true
}
```
And on customer side:
```
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "redwood_iface" {
  vpc_id = var.customer_vpc
  service_name = data.aws_vpc_endpoint_service.redwood.service_name
  subnets = var.iface_subnets
  security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.ep_sg.id]
}
```
carla_neteng: For subnets: ask them to provision at least 3 private subnets (one per AZ) with /24s that can host interface endpoints. Example: 10.20.10.0/24, 10.20.20.0/24, 10.20.30.0/24. Security group for the endpoint should allow inbound 443 from their app CIDRs only.
dan_security: Security checklist items to include in the SOW/POC:
- VPC flow logs enabled and shared (S3 or CloudWatch) for the POC duration
- SG restrict inbound to customer pod ranges (no 0.0.0.0/0)
- TLS termination at NLB with our cert; recommend mutual TLS if customer requires client auth
- KMS key usage: if they want customer-managed keys for logs or storage, we need details
- Auditing: CloudTrail + ELB access logs enabled
oli_se: FYI on the licensing/pricing angle: for a short POC, we can issue scoped hosted API keys (rate-limited) and no dedicated pool. If they prove throughput > X rps or want isolated GPUs, we provision a Dedicated pool (monthly/commit). For PrivateLink access to hosted control plane, we still need PrivateLink endpoints to our control plane NLB.
maria_sales: Customer asks if we can support on-prem -> TGW -> interface endpoint. They use Transit Gateway. Any blockers?
carla_neteng: Works fine. Customer's TGW can propagate to the VPC hosting the interface endpoints. Key notes:
- Interface endpoints must be in the VPC where they attach subnets
- If using TGW, ensure route propagation to the subnets housing the endpoints AND SGs allow the TGW CIDRs
- No need to peer our VPC in this scenario
ben_solutions: Practical gotchas we've hit:
- Customer security teams sometimes block interface endpoints by default; ask them to whitelist aws-vpc-endpoint DNS suffix in their proxy
- Acceptance_required on our endpoint service means we must manually accept the endpoint connection (ben will take that step)
carla_neteng: Example route/security checklist to send to customer (copy-able):
```
- Subnets: 3x private subnets (one/AZ) for interface endpoints
- Endpoint SG: inbound from customer app CIDR (443), outbound to our NLB CIDR
- TGW/Routing: ensure subnets hosting endpoints have routes to TGW attachment
- NACLs: allow ephemeral port range 1024-65535 outbound if using ephemeral connections
- DNS: enable private DNS for the endpoint or add a CNAME to their internal DNS
```
dan_security: Also ask for their threat model answers in the security questionnaire section:
- Do they require client certs (mTLS)?
- Do they want IP allowlist + short-lived tokens?
- Do they require dedicated HSM-backed keys or are our managed KMS keys OK for POC?
maria_sales: Action items / owners:
- maria_sales: collect ACME CIDR ranges and their TGW attachment ID by EOD tomorrow
- ben_solutions: create the endpoint service in our infra and share service_name (will set acceptance_required) — ETA 24h
- carla_neteng: prepare terraform example + SG/ALB config and a one-page runbook — ETA 48h
- dan_security: fill the security questionnaire answers with the above checklist and flag any blocker — ETA 48h
- deploy-bot: once ben creates svc, ping this thread with acceptance request
everyone: please react with :thumbsup: if the plan looks good or note objections.
ben_solutions: I'll also include a short troubleshooting snippet for customers if they can't reach endpoint:
```
# from customer subnet
curl -vk https://vpce-<id>.execute-api.amazonaws.com/health
# check: sg, route to TGW, NACLs, private DNS
```
maria_sales: Great — I'll send this as the network appendix in the POC email. tagging the ACME infra lead to get the subnets. :rocket:
